name: persona-desktop
description: Persona's desktop shell around the hub-hosted web app

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js && node --test scripts/update-test-cache.test.mjs scripts/update-test-receipts.test.mjs scripts/update-test-native.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
